title: Your first robot pick & place
summary: Follow a recorded robot program from its first move to a successful delivery. Four moments, explained at your own pace.

steps.title: Read the active command
steps.body: The editor highlights the command currently running. Here, robot.lowerTo(12) is active while the gripper descends toward the blue block. Follow the highlighted line and compare it with the arm’s position.
steps.alt: Highlighted lowerTo command beside the descending robot gripper
steps.note: This recording begins with a loaded program. It does not show how to create the project or enter its initial configuration.

steps.title: Carry the block to its target
steps.body: The gripper status reads Holding A and the tool height reads 100 mm. The highlighted moveTo command carries the block toward the target at x = 140, y = −120. Notice that the arm moves while the block remains attached.
steps.alt: Robot carrying block A while moveTo is highlighted

steps.title: Follow the placement sequence
steps.body: The recorded program lowers the block, releases it, then lifts the tool. Use the replay to follow the transition into placement; the screenshot captures one moment in that sequence.
steps.alt: Robot at the destination during the placement sequence
steps.note: The sampled frames do not establish the exact release instant. This step needs a continuous-playback check before being used as precise timing guidance.

steps.title: Check the delivery result
steps.body: The challenge panel shows 1 / 1 delivered and the console reports Challenge complete. The gripper is open and the tool has lifted to 100 mm. Those visible indicators confirm the recorded run finished successfully.
steps.alt: Challenge complete message and one of one blocks delivered
steps.note: This is a walkthrough of the version shown in the recording. It is not an independently replayed test of the current live app.
